caption: The drawing features a single, woven basket as its subject, depicted centered against a plain, light beige background. The basket is predominantly brown with various shades representing the natural color variations of the woven materials. The basket has a wide, rounded body that narrows toward the rim and a single sturdy handle arching from one side to the other. The rim and handle are reinforced with thicker, flat strips, and a binding joins the handle and rim together at the top center. The woven texture of the basket is illustrated in detail, showing the interlacing strips that form the body. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name “BISBY FINLEY” is written in small, capitalized letters.
title: Wicker Basket
